title: Watercolor Flowers Repeating Pattern
author: Mermaids Cove
description:
WATERCOLOR FLORALS seamless pattern, digital papers, backgrounds, flower pattern digital scrapbook paper pack, 25 repeating patterns flowers
Delicate and dainty watercolor flowers. A stunning and pretty set of designs featuring pastel water color flowers in pink, purple and blue. A set of 25 floral seamless repeating patterns. Can be used as digital papers for scrapbooking and crafting, backgrounds, or repeat the tiles to create a seamless repeating pattern.
• 25 digital paper/background/pattern image files
• these designs ARE SEAMLESS and can be joined together for a repeating pattern
• you will receive the papers in JPG files
• high resolution, high quality images
• 4096 x 4096 pixels in size, scaleable images
Introducing the Watercolor Flowers Seamless Pattern Digital Paper Pack – an exquisite set of 25 repeating patterns designed to add a touch of floral elegance to your crafting projects. This digital download features stunning dainty flowers in hues of pink, purple, and blue, with a range of white, light and darker brackgrounds.
Each design in this set has been expertly crafted to seamlessly repeat, allowing you to create beautiful backgrounds, digital papers, and even fabric patterns without any noticeable seams. You will receive 25 individual JPG files that are high-resolution and high-quality, measuring an impressive 4096 x 4096 pixels.
Whether you’re a digital or physical scrapbooker, a website or graphic designer, or simply looking to create stunning printed materials, these digital papers are sure to impress. They can be used for a variety of crafting projects, including custom invitations, greeting cards, and even home decor items.
